Its 'CONFIRMED GAP' section (lines 23-71) and its AC4/AC4a section (lines 139-158) still assert, in the present tense, that 'complete_task/3's own rewired REQ-050 call site does not actually intercept the realistic case', that AC4a's test 'asserts the return value is the pre-REQ-061 shape ({:error, {:activation_failed, ...}})...
